snippet.title: One of the Rarest Konami Games! Code One Dispatch! A Forgotten About Arcade Racing Game I LOVE
snippet.description:
Everyone loves rare retro games and everyone loves rare arcade games and everyone loves Konami games...so here is Code One Dispatch from Konami! The entire game, never captured before for YouTube! It's one of the best retro games ever IMO when it comes to arcade racing games and its super obscure!

SUPPORT THE CHANNEL : http://www.patreon.com/VideoGameEsoterica

I have been trying to find a copy of Code One Dispatch to add to my arcade PCB collection for over a year...and I was able to arrange a deal with someone I know from Germany to get a copy of the game in my collection...as its not as simple as just writing a new card to the Konami Viper PCB...it requires a bit of reverse engineering! So it's half retro gaming review and half video game preservation project!

SUPPORT THE CHANNEL : http://www.patreon.com/VideoGameEsoterica

Patreon Thanks : Seth Peterson, Tim Hugall, John Thompson, Paul Daniel, Porch, Jon Anderson,  RayceARoni,Kuranghi, Jason Hixon, Sam Matthews, Alex Tessler, Jonathan Leung, Martin Donlon, Tom Van Deusen, Barabob, Steve Randall, shotgunl, Andrew Bunch, K-2, Eric Walklet, 
J Z, Ivan Wennerholm, Adrien Sebbane, tobemorecrazy, Mark DeRiddler, Mike Puchelinkx, Tony Escobar and H7!

Code 1 Dispatch from Konami is one of the absolute weirdest arcade racing franchises around but sadly its a very obscure gaming footnote in the pantheon of arcade games. You will never hear Code One Dispatch in the same conversation as something like Daytona USA, Scud Race or Ridge Racer...but you should! Because Code One Dispatch is obscure gaming history and it needs to be experienced!

Basically if you have ever played Emergency Call Ambulance on the Sega Model 3...you will know what Code One Dispatch is like...but unlike Sega's arcade efforts...this game goes even HARDER! It's like San Francisco Rush minus the racing!

Sadly the Konami Viper emulation in MAME isn't ready for primetime yet as all of the games are unplayable. Hopefully a real hardware capture like this helps the emulator progress to the point where you can play at home...because this is a rare video game and its def something that needs some video game preservation put behind it!

THIS IS THE LONG PLAY

Questions? Comments? Just leave them below and I will do my best to answer each and every one of them!

http://www.patreon.com/VideoGameEsoterica

You can follow us at IG : ChicagoGameCollector , or join our Discord Server : https://discord.gg/vGbsBzJ

VGE
